# Can and cannot

## What you will learn
Can expresses ability or permission; cannot (can’t) expresses inability or prohibition. The next verb is always the base form.

## Example in context
I can swim, but I cannot fly. Can you swim?

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
Do not say can to swim or cans swim.

## Practice and reflection
Translate: «Она умеет читать».
**Model answer:** She can read.

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
